steps.expression: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('[data-slot="dialog-content"] [data-model-settings-group="tokens"] input'); const image = document.querySelector('[data-slot="dialog-content"] [data-model-input-modality="image"]'); const reasoning = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot="dialog-content"] [data-model-settings-group="reasoning"] [data-model-reasoning-chip]')].map(e => e.textContent?.trim()).filter(Boolean); const context = input?.value || input?.getAttribute('placeholder') || ''; return !!input && /^\d+$/.test(context) && Number(context) > 0 && image?.getAttribute('data-selected') === 'true' && JSON.stringify(reasoning) === JSON.stringify(['none','minimal','low','medium','high','xhigh','max']); })()
